1.w: “Comfort, comfort My people,” says your⁺ God.

2.w: “Speak upon the heart of Jerusalem, and call out to her, that her service has been fulfilled, that her iniquity has been pardoned, for she has received from the hand of YHWH double for all her sins.”

3.w: The voice of one calling in the wilderness: “Prepare the way of YHWH, make straight in the desert plain a highway for our God.

4.w: Every valley will be lifted up, and every mountain and hill brought low; and the crooked will become straight, and the rugged a plain;

5.w: and the glory of YHWH will be revealed, and all flesh together will see [it]. For the mouth of YHWH has spoken.”

6.w: The voice of one saying: “Call out!” And he said, “What shall I call out?” “All flesh [is] grass, and all its loveliness [is] like the flower of the field.

7.w: The grass withers, the flower fades, because the breath of YHWH blows on it. Surely the people [are] grass.

8.w: The grass withers, the flower fades, and the word of our God stands forever.”

9.w: Upon a high mountain go up yourself, O Zion, bringing news! Lift up with strength your voice [to] Jerusalem, bringing news! Lift [it] up, do not be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold your⁺ God!”

10.w: Behold, the Lord YHWH will come with might, and His arm will rule for Him. Behold, His reward [is] with Him and His work [is] before His face.

11.w: Like a shepherd He will pasture His flock; He gathers the lambs with His arm, and in His bosom He carries [them], the nursing ones He leads.

12.w: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of His hand and marked off the heavens with a handspan, and has held the dust of the earth in a measure, and has weighed the mountains on a scale, and the hills in scales?

13.w: Who has directed the Spirit of YHWH, or informed Him as the man of His counsel?

14.w: With whom did he counsel, and [who] gave Him understanding and instructed Him in the path of justice? And [who] taught Him knowledge, and informed Him the way of understanding?

15.w: Behold, the nations [are] like a drop from a bucket, and they have been reckoned like dust of the scales! Behold, the islands He lifts up like fine dust,

16.w: and Lebanon [is] not sufficient to burn, and its beasts [are] not sufficient for a burnt offering.

17.w: All the nations [are] as nothing before Him, they are counted by Him [as less] than nothing and emptiness.

18.w: And to whom would you⁺ liken God? And what likeness will you⁺ arrange for Him?

19.w: To an idol a craftsman casts, and a metalworker overlays it with gold and fits with chains of silver?

20.w: One bereft of a contribution chooses a tree not rotten, and a skillful craftsman seeks out for himself to prepare a carved image [that] will not topple?

21.w: Do you⁺ not know? Have you⁺ not heard? Has it not been declared from the beginning to you⁺? Have you⁺ not understood from the foundations of the earth?

22.w: He is sitting above the circle of the earth, and its dwellers [are] like grasshoppers; He stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and He spreads them out like a tent to dwell [in].

23.w: The One giving the rulers to nothingness, He makes the rulers of the earth as emptiness.

24.w: Yes, they are hardly planted; yes, they are hardly sown; Yes their stem has hardly taken root in the earth. And also He will blow on them, and they will wither, and the tempest will carry them off like the stubble.

25.w: “And to whom will you⁺ liken Me? Or [who] is My equal?” Says the Holy One.

26.w: Lift up your⁺ eyes on high and see who has created these [things]—the One having brought forth by number their host. He calls to them all by name; by the greatness of might and the strength of power, not one is missing.

27.w: Why do you say, O Jacob, and speak, O Israel, “My way Is hidden from YHWH, and my claim is passed over by my God”?

28.w: Have you not known? Or have you not heard? God everlasting [is] YHWH, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He does not faint and He does not grow weary; [there is] no searching out of His understanding.

29.w: He gives power to the weary, and to those with no might, He increases strength.

30.w: Even youths will faint and grow weary, and young men will stumble and fall;

31.w: and those waiting on YHWH will renew [their] strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
